# conductorone_sign_in_policy (Resource)

SignInPolicy Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "conductorone_sign_in_policy" "my_signinpolicy" {
  allowed_mfa_types = [
    "CREDENTIAL_TYPE_DELEGATED_GOOGLE"
  ]
  allowed_primary_types = [
    "CREDENTIAL_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED"
  ]
  default_outcome = {
    allow = {
      floor_level = "AUTH_LEVEL_UNSPECIFIED"
    }
    challenge_required = {
      types = [
        "CREDENTIAL_TYPE_DELEGATED_GOOGLE"
      ]
    }
    deny = {
      reason_admin = "...my_reason_admin..."
      reason_user  = "...my_reason_user..."
    }
    enrollment_required = {
      credential_types = [
        "CREDENTIAL_TYPE_TOTP"
      ]
    }
    step_up_required = {
      level           = "AUTH_LEVEL_UNSPECIFIED"
      max_age_seconds = 4
      types = [
        "CREDENTIAL_TYPE_EMAIL_OTP"
      ]
    }
  }
  display_name = "...my_display_name..."
  priority     = 6
  rules = [
    {
      description = "...my_description..."
      id          = "...my_id..."
      match_cel   = "...my_match_cel..."
      mode        = "POLICY_RULE_MODE_DISABLED"
      outcome = {
        allow = {
          floor_level = "AUTH_LEVEL_PHR"
        }
        challenge_required = {
          types = [
            "CREDENTIAL_TYPE_DELEGATED_GOOGLE"
          ]
        }
        deny = {
          reason_admin = "...my_reason_admin..."
          reason_user  = "...my_reason_user..."
        }
        enrollment_required = {
          credential_types = [
            "CREDENTIAL_TYPE_TOTP"
          ]
        }
        step_up_required = {
          level           = "AUTH_LEVEL_PHR"
          max_age_seconds = 3
          types = [
            "CREDENTIAL_TYPE_RECOVERY_CODE"
          ]
        }
      }
    }
  ]
  sign_in_policy_service_delete_request = {
    # ...
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) A human-readable name for the policy.

### Optional

- `allowed_mfa_types` (List of String) The credential types accepted as a second factor.
- `allowed_primary_types` (List of String) The primary credential types users may sign in with.
- `default_outcome` (Attributes) PolicyOutcome is the effect of a matched rule. Exactly one kind is set.

This message contains a oneof named kind. Only a single field of the following list may be set at a time:
  - allow
  - deny
  - stepUpRequired
  - challengeRequired
  - enrollmentRequired (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default_outcome))
- `priority` (Number) When a user matches more than one policy, the policy with the highest
 priority applies.
- `rules` (Attributes List) The ordered rule cascade. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `sign_in_policy_service_delete_request` (Attributes) The SignInPolicyServiceDeleteRequest message. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sign_in_policy_service_delete_request))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the policy.
- `is_builtin` (Boolean) True for built-in policies provided by ConductorOne. Built-in policies
 cannot be edited or deleted.
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--default_outcome"></a>
### Nested Schema for `default_outcome`

Optional:

- `allow` (Attributes) Allow permits the sign-in. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default_outcome--allow))
- `challenge_required` (Attributes) ChallengeRequired asks for an additional factor before the sign-in completes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default_outcome--challenge_required))
- `deny` (Attributes) Deny rejects the sign-in. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default_outcome--deny))
- `enrollment_required` (Attributes) EnrollmentRequired tells the user to enroll a credential before continuing. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default_outcome--enrollment_required))
- `step_up_required` (Attributes) StepUpRequired demands a stronger re-authentication before access is granted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default_outcome--step_up_required))

<a id="nestedatt--default_outcome--allow"></a>
### Nested Schema for `default_outcome.allow`

Optional:

- `floor_level` (String) The minimum assurance level that satisfies this rule. Required on enforced
 Allow rules.
possible known values include one of ["AUTH_LEVEL_UNSPECIFIED", "AUTH_LEVEL_NONE", "AUTH_LEVEL_SINGLE_FACTOR", "AUTH_LEVEL_MULTI_FACTOR", "AUTH_LEVEL_PHR", "AUTH_LEVEL_PHRH"]

### Nested Schema for `default_outcome.challenge_required`

Optional:

- `types` (List of String) The credential types that may satisfy the challenge.


<a id="nestedatt--default_outcome--deny"></a>
### Nested Schema for `default_outcome.deny`

Optional:

- `reason_admin` (String) Reason shown in admin-only audit.
- `reason_user` (String) Reason safe to show the end user.


<a id="nestedatt--default_outcome--enrollment_required"></a>
### Nested Schema for `default_outcome.enrollment_required`

Optional:

- `credential_types` (List of String) The credential types the user may enroll. Empty means "complete identity
 verification first".


<a id="nestedatt--default_outcome--step_up_required"></a>
### Nested Schema for `default_outcome.step_up_required`

Optional:

- `level` (String) The assurance level the step-up must reach. possible known values include one of ["AUTH_LEVEL_UNSPECIFIED", "AUTH_LEVEL_NONE", "AUTH_LEVEL_SINGLE_FACTOR", "AUTH_LEVEL_MULTI_FACTOR", "AUTH_LEVEL_PHR", "AUTH_LEVEL_PHRH"]
- `max_age_seconds` (Number) How fresh the step-up must be, in seconds.
- `types` (List of String) The credential types that may satisfy the step-up.



<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Optional:

- `description` (String) A human-readable description shown in the admin UI.
- `id` (String) A stable identifier for the rule, surfaced in audit.
- `match_cel` (String) A boolean condition expression evaluated against the sign-in context.
- `mode` (String) Whether the rule is live, evaluated-only, or skipped. possible known values include one of ["POLICY_RULE_MODE_UNSPECIFIED", "POLICY_RULE_MODE_ENFORCE", "POLICY_RULE_MODE_OBSERVE", "POLICY_RULE_MODE_DISABLED"]
- `outcome` (Attributes) PolicyOutcome is the effect of a matched rule. Exactly one kind is set.

This message contains a oneof named kind. Only a single field of the following list may be set at a time:
  - allow
  - deny
  - stepUpRequired
  - challengeRequired
  - enrollmentRequired (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--outcome))

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = conductorone_sign_in_policy.my_conductorone_sign_in_policy
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import conductorone_sign_in_policy.my_conductorone_sign_in_policy "..."
```
